ideas.pitch: A smart waste segregation and collection tracking web application tailored for institutional campuses like NHCE.
ideas.title: CampusCare Waste & Resource Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a visible campus-level operational problem directly relevant to the AICTE IDEA Lab and college administration judging the event, following the successful local-problem-solving pattern of TrashMaster.

ideas.pitch: An official submission, resource sharing, and peer-review portal designed specifically for managing ideathon events and student project lifecycles.
ideas.title: IdeaHub NHCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers and judges love tools that solve their own administrative bottlenecks, directly mirroring the appeal of portal-based hackathon winners like Innohack-26.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic assistant that indexes lecture slides and lab notes to instantly answer student doubts and generate customized revision quizzes.
ideas.title: EduMentor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets student pain points directly inside the college ecosystem, using a localized RAG approach similar to the proven winner Voz-AI and aura.

ideas.pitch: An internal equipment and component booking system for the AICTE IDEA Lab to manage hardware availability, project components, and tool usage.
ideas.title: LabEquip Share
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the hosting department (AICTE IDEA Lab) by organizing and optimizing their physical lab inventory and machinery access.

ideas.pitch: A centralized project repository and documentation handoff platform for final year students to pass their research and prototypes down to junior batches.
ideas.title: CampusKnowledge Transfer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves institutional knowledge loss across graduating batches, mirroring the engineering lifecycle intelligence approach of devflow.
